context.genre: Short fiction with contemporary and embedded historical narratives
context.background: Complete user-supplied document, comprising its title and ten numbered sections. Narrative statements and the narrator's revisions must be assessed in their local narrative context.

extraction.method: Direct body-paragraph w:t extraction from word/document.xml; paragraph arrays cross-checked with ElementTree and minidom.
extraction.serialization: UTF-8 without BOM; all DOCX body paragraphs, including empty paragraphs, joined with two LF characters, followed by one final LF.
extraction.changes: No wording, punctuation, title, numbering, or paragraph-order changes. DOCX page layout, fonts, and heading styles are not encoded in the text fixture.
